    <h1 class="devsite-page-title" tabindex="-1">
      API errors<devsite-actions hidden data-nosnippet>
    <devsite-llm-tools></devsite-llm-tools></devsite-actions>
  
      
    </h1>
  <div class="devsite-page-title-meta"><devsite-view-release-notes></devsite-view-release-notes></div>
  

  <devsite-toc class="devsite-nav"
    depth="2"
    devsite-toc-embedded
    >
  </devsite-toc>
  
    
  <div class="devsite-article-body clearfix
  ">

  
    
    
<div id="gemini-api-switcher-trigger" style="display:none;"></div>

<p>
</p>



<p>This page provides a reference for all Interactions API error codes, describes the
error response format, and explains how the API delivers errors for different request types.</p>

<h2 id="api-error-codes" data-text="Standard API error codes" tabindex="-1">Standard API error codes</h2>

<p>These general request-level error codes correspond to standard HTTP status codes.
Use the <code translate="no" dir="ltr">code</code> field in your application logic to handle errors programmatically.</p>

<table>
<thead>
<tr>
<th style="text-align: left">Code</th>
<th style="text-align: left">HTTP Status</th>
<th style="text-align: left">Description</th>
<th style="text-align: left">Recommended action</th>
</tr>
</thead>

<tbody>
<tr>
<td style="text-align: left"><code translate="no" dir="ltr">invalid_request</code></td>
<td style="text-align: left">400 Bad Request</td>
<td style="text-align: left">The request payload is malformed or contains invalid parameters.</td>
<td style="text-align: left">Check your request syntax and parameters against the <a href="/api/interactions-api">API reference</a>.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td style="text-align: left"><code translate="no" dir="ltr">failed_precondition</code></td>
<td style="text-align: left">400 Bad Request</td>
<td style="text-align: left">The request cannot be processed because a prerequisite is not met (for example, disabled billing).</td>
<td style="text-align: left">Verify project billing status or account prerequisites.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td style="text-align: left"><code translate="no" dir="ltr">out_of_range</code></td>
<td style="text-align: left">416 Requested Range Not Satisfiable</td>
<td style="text-align: left">Request parameter is outside the valid range.</td>
<td style="text-align: left">Check parameter values and limits.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td style="text-align: left"><code translate="no" dir="ltr">parameter_unknown</code></td>
<td style="text-align: left">400 Bad Request</td>
<td style="text-align: left">The request contains an unknown parameter.</td>
<td style="text-align: left">Remove the unrecognized parameter and retry.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td style="text-align: left"><code translate="no" dir="ltr">authentication</code></td>
<td style="text-align: left">401 Unauthorized</td>
<td style="text-align: left">The API key is missing, invalid, or expired.</td>
<td style="text-align: left">Verify your <a href="/gemini-api/docs/api-key">API key</a>.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td style="text-align: left"><code translate="no" dir="ltr">permission_denied</code></td>
<td style="text-align: left">403 Forbidden</td>
<td style="text-align: left">Your API key does not have permission for this resource.</td>
<td style="text-align: left">Check your API key permissions and project access.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td style="text-align: left"><code translate="no" dir="ltr">not_found</code></td>
<td style="text-align: left">404 Not Found</td>
<td style="text-align: left">The requested resource was not found.</td>
<td style="text-align: left">Verify the resource path and parameters.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td style="text-align: left"><code translate="no" dir="ltr">model_not_found</code></td>
<td style="text-align: left">404 Not Found</td>
<td style="text-align: left">The specified model was not found.</td>
<td style="text-align: left">Verify the model name or fall back to a different model.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td style="text-align: left"><code translate="no" dir="ltr">already_exists</code></td>
<td style="text-align: left">409 Conflict</td>
<td style="text-align: left">The entity you attempted to create already exists.</td>
<td style="text-align: left">Check if the resource already exists before re-creating.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td style="text-align: left"><code translate="no" dir="ltr">aborted</code></td>
<td style="text-align: left">409 Conflict</td>
<td style="text-align: left">The operation was aborted due to a conflict or concurrency check failure.</td>
<td style="text-align: left">Retry the request at a higher application level.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td style="text-align: left"><code translate="no" dir="ltr">rate_limit_exceeded</code></td>
<td style="text-align: left">429 Too Many Requests</td>
<td style="text-align: left">You have exceeded the per-minute or per-second request or token limit.</td>
<td style="text-align: left">Wait and retry with exponential backoff.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td style="text-align: left"><code translate="no" dir="ltr">quota_exceeded</code></td>
<td style="text-align: left">429 Too Many Requests</td>
<td style="text-align: left">You have exceeded your daily quota.</td>
<td style="text-align: left">Wait until the quota resets or request a quota increase.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td style="text-align: left"><code translate="no" dir="ltr">too_many_requests</code></td>
<td style="text-align: left">429 Too Many Requests</td>
<td style="text-align: left">You have made too many requests in a short period of time.</td>
<td style="text-align: left">Wait and retry with exponential backoff.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td style="text-align: left"><code translate="no" dir="ltr">cancelled</code></td>
<td style="text-align: left">499 Client Closed Request</td>
<td style="text-align: left">The client cancelled the request before it completed.</td>
<td style="text-align: left">No action needed. This usually means the client disconnected.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td style="text-align: left"><code translate="no" dir="ltr">api_error</code></td>
<td style="text-align: left">500 Internal Server Error</td>
<td style="text-align: left">An unexpected error occurred on the server.</td>
<td style="text-align: left">Retry the request. If it persists, contact support.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td style="text-align: left"><code translate="no" dir="ltr">unimplemented</code></td>
<td style="text-align: left">501 Not Implemented</td>
<td style="text-align: left">The operation or feature is not implemented or supported.</td>
<td style="text-align: left">Check API capabilities or switch to a supported feature.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td style="text-align: left"><code translate="no" dir="ltr">service_unavailable</code></td>
<td style="text-align: left">503 Service Unavailable</td>
<td style="text-align: left">The service is temporarily overloaded or down.</td>
<td style="text-align: left">Wait and retry with exponential backoff.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td style="text-align: left"><code translate="no" dir="ltr">deadline_exceeded</code></td>
<td style="text-align: left">504 Gateway Timeout</td>
<td style="text-align: left">The request didn&#39;t finish within the deadline.</td>
<td style="text-align: left">Remove or increase client deadline setting to use the server default.</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<aside class="note"><strong>Note:</strong><span> Any error code not listed above falls back to the <code translate="no" dir="ltr">snake_case</code> version of the HTTP status.</span></aside>
<h2 id="generation-blocked-codes" data-text="Generation blocked codes" tabindex="-1">Generation blocked codes</h2>

<p>These error codes indicate that policy, safety, or content restrictions blocked the model&#39;s output. When you receive one of these codes, modify your input and retry.</p>

<table>
<thead>
<tr>
<th style="text-align: left">Code</th>
<th style="text-align: left">Description</th>
</tr>
</thead>

<tbody>
<tr>
<td style="text-align: left"><code translate="no" dir="ltr">safety</code></td>
<td style="text-align: left">Safety violations (harmful content) blocked the request.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td style="text-align: left"><code translate="no" dir="ltr">recitation</code></td>
<td style="text-align: left">Copyright or recitation restrictions blocked the request.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td style="text-align: left"><code translate="no" dir="ltr">language</code></td>
<td style="text-align: left">An unsupported language blocked the request.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td style="text-align: left"><code translate="no" dir="ltr">prohibited_content</code></td>
<td style="text-align: left">Prohibited content guidelines blocked the request.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td style="text-align: left"><code translate="no" dir="ltr">spii</code></td>
<td style="text-align: left">Sensitive Personally Identifiable Information restrictions blocked the request.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td style="text-align: left"><code translate="no" dir="ltr">blocklist</code></td>
<td style="text-align: left">Prohibited terms on a blocklist blocked the request.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td style="text-align: left"><code translate="no" dir="ltr">image_safety</code></td>
<td style="text-align: left">Safety violations blocked image generation.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td style="text-align: left"><code translate="no" dir="ltr">image_prohibited_content</code></td>
<td style="text-align: left">Prohibited content guidelines blocked image generation.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td style="text-align: left"><code translate="no" dir="ltr">image_recitation</code></td>
<td style="text-align: left">Copyright or recitation restrictions blocked image generation.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td style="text-align: left"><code translate="no" dir="ltr">image_other</code></td>
<td style="text-align: left">Unspecified reasons blocked image generation.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td style="text-align: left"><code translate="no" dir="ltr">content_blocked</code></td>
<td style="text-align: left">An unspecified policy reason blocked the request.</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>

<h2 id="generation-error-codes" data-text="Generation error codes" tabindex="-1">Generation error codes</h2>

<p>These error codes indicate a structural issue with the model&#39;s generated output (such as a malformed function call or an undeclared tool call).</p>

<table>
<thead>
<tr>
<th style="text-align: left">Code</th>
<th style="text-align: left">Description</th>
</tr>
</thead>

<tbody>
<tr>
<td style="text-align: left"><code translate="no" dir="ltr">malformed_function_call</code></td>
<td style="text-align: left">The model produced a function call that could not be parsed.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td style="text-align: left"><code translate="no" dir="ltr">malformed_tool_call</code></td>
<td style="text-align: left">The model produced a tool call that could not be parsed.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td style="text-align: left"><code translate="no" dir="ltr">unexpected_tool_call</code></td>
<td style="text-align: left">The model called a tool that was not declared in the request.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td style="text-align: left"><code translate="no" dir="ltr">no_image</code></td>
<td style="text-align: left">The model was unable to generate an image.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td style="text-align: left"><code translate="no" dir="ltr">too_many_tool_calls</code></td>
<td style="text-align: left">The model generated more tool calls than allowed.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td style="text-align: left"><code translate="no" dir="ltr">missing_thought_signature</code></td>
<td style="text-align: left">The response is missing a required thought signature.</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>

<h2 id="error-schema" data-text="Error response format" tabindex="-1">Error response format</h2>

<p>All errors from the Interactions API return an <code translate="no" dir="ltr">error</code> object containing a <code translate="no" dir="ltr">code</code> and <code translate="no" dir="ltr">message</code>. For example, passing an unsupported tool type returns:</p>
<div></div><devsite-code><pre class="devsite-click-to-copy" translate="no" dir="ltr" is-upgraded syntax="JSON"><code translate="no" dir="ltr"><span class="devsite-syntax-p">{</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">  </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nt">"error"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">:</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">{</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">    </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nt">"code"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">:</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"invalid_request"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">,</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">    </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nt">"message"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">:</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"The value 'invalid_tool_type_xyz' is not supported for 'type' at 'tools[0]'. Supported values: 'function', 'code_execution', 'mcp_server', 'filesystem', 'google_maps', 'google_search', 'bash', 'computer_use', 'file_search', 'url_context'."</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">  </span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">}</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-p">}</span>
</code></pre></devsite-code>
<table>
<thead>
<tr>
<th style="text-align: left">Field</th>
<th style="text-align: left">Type</th>
<th style="text-align: left">Description</th>
</tr>
</thead>

<tbody>
<tr>
<td style="text-align: left"><code translate="no" dir="ltr">code</code></td>
<td style="text-align: left">string</td>
<td style="text-align: left">A machine-readable error code in <code translate="no" dir="ltr">snake_case</code>.</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td style="text-align: left"><code translate="no" dir="ltr">message</code></td>
<td style="text-align: left">string</td>
<td style="text-align: left">A human-readable description of what went wrong.</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>

<h2 id="error-delivery" data-text="How errors are delivered" tabindex="-1">How errors are delivered</h2>

<p>The API delivers errors differently depending on whether you make a standard HTTP request or a streaming (SSE) request.</p>

<h3 id="http-errors" data-text="Standard HTTP requests" tabindex="-1">Standard HTTP requests</h3>

<p>For standard (non-streaming) requests, the API sets the HTTP response status code (such as <code translate="no" dir="ltr">400 Bad Request</code>, <code translate="no" dir="ltr">401 Unauthorized</code>, or <code translate="no" dir="ltr">429 Too Many Requests</code>) and returns an <code translate="no" dir="ltr">error</code> object in the JSON response body:</p>
<div></div><devsite-code><pre class="devsite-click-to-copy" translate="no" dir="ltr" is-upgraded syntax="JSON"><code translate="no" dir="ltr"><span class="devsite-syntax-p">{</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">  </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nt">"error"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">:</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">{</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">    </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nt">"code"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">:</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"invalid_request"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">,</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">    </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nt">"message"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">:</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"The value 'invalid_tool_type_xyz' is not supported for 'type' at 'tools[0]'."</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">  </span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">}</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-p">}</span>
</code></pre></devsite-code>
<h3 id="sse-errors" data-text="Streaming (SSE) requests" tabindex="-1">Streaming (SSE) requests</h3>

<p>For streaming requests (<code translate="no" dir="ltr">stream: true</code>), the API sends error events over the Server-Sent Events (SSE) stream with <code translate="no" dir="ltr">event_type</code> set to <code translate="no" dir="ltr">&quot;error&quot;</code>. The <code translate="no" dir="ltr">error</code> field contains the same <code translate="no" dir="ltr">code</code> and <code translate="no" dir="ltr">message</code> structure:</p>
<div></div><devsite-code><pre class="devsite-click-to-copy" translate="no" dir="ltr" is-upgraded syntax="JSON"><code translate="no" dir="ltr"><span class="devsite-syntax-p">{</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">  </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nt">"event_type"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">:</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"error"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">,</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">  </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nt">"error"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">:</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">{</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">    </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nt">"code"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">:</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"not_found"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">,</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">    </span><span class="devsite-syntax-nt">"message"</span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">:</span><span class="devsite-syntax-w"> </span><span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"Failed to get completed interaction: Result not found."</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-w">  </span><span class="devsite-syntax-p">}</span>
<span class="devsite-syntax-p">}</span>
</code></pre></devsite-code>
<p>For the full SSE event schema, see the <a href="/api/interactions-api">Interactions API Reference</a>.</p>

</ul>
